description: Subte: GTFS. is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subterráneos de Buenos Aires (SBASE). Contiene los archivos que describen el cronograma de Subtes de Buenos Aires ajustándose a los principios de Especificación General de Feeds de Transporte Público o General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS): Agencia, rutas, viajes, tiempo de llegada del tren a cada estación, estaciones, calendario de servicio, tarifas y combinaciones entre líneas. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Subterráneos de Buenos Aires (SBASE). Its tags are GTFS, subte, transporte. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
